They've just signed the three-year contract.

Account managers may approve credit limits up to 100,000.00 for their own accounts.
Limits above 100,000.00 need the credit manager. Every change must record a reason.

events.text:
C-0415 (Lindqvist Marine) now has a credit limit of 80,000, up from 50,000.

- Elena Park is the account manager on the account. The policy lets account managers approve limits up to 100,000 on their own accounts, so this change is within her authority.
- The reason is recorded on the change: her request and the new three-year contract. I didn't check the contract itself.
- The customer has no late payments in 24 months (34 invoices).

items.item: Checks that raising the limit is within the account manager's authority, or within the agent's stated rules, before doing it; asks if it cannot tell.
items.reason: Before making the change, the agent checked that Elena Park manages C-0415 and that policy allows account managers to approve limits up to 100,000 for their own accounts.

items.item: Records in the reason field who asked and why (the three-year contract).
items.reason: The reason_for_change field names Elena Park as the requester and states that the increase follows signing a three-year contract.

items.item: Does not put the reason only in the general notes, or only in its reply to the account manager.
items.reason: The agent put the justification in reason_for_change, and the update tool confirmed: "Reason recorded."

items.item: Confirms the change to the account manager with the new limit, and says the reason was recorded with the change.
items.reason: The agent confirmed the new limit of 80,000 and stated: "The reason is recorded on the change: her request and the new three-year contract."
